source: #157 A-L1 (pi-durable opened inside herdr through one layout.apply). Provenance, in this order and not to be blended with revision 12's same-pass history: main wrote the three complete NEXT literals before any producer edit, reading the old values from d612913's Root text; Astra independently approved all three unchanged (review 9cf7f7); only then were they recorded here and applied to the producer. The old values are d612913's Root text.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside you and hand it a first task. The launch rail follows THIS agent's process context; tmux placement can be explicitly named: inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) it opens a NEW UNFOCUSED TAB in your own herdr workspace, pi and claude-code only; everywhere else it opens in the operator's tmux with all six backends (pi, claude-code, copilot, omp, codex, pi-durable). No fallback: an incomplete herdr context is refused by name, never by a tmux window you cannot see from herdr. The sibling is asked to call back before its task with the launch nonce; match that nonce and use the callback sender envelope for its garden id. This returns a LAUNCH receipt (the owner's coordinates plus that nonce): it does NOT mean the runtime started, the first turn ran, or the task was delivered. Those coordinates are a VIEW, never an address — a herdr tab/pane id can change under a running sibling. Nothing polls. For EXISTING citizens use entwurf_v2 — this tool only creates, and entwurf_peers only reports. Model is REQUIRED and passed to the chosen runtime CLI (`provider/model` for pi, an id/alias for Claude Code, `provider/model id` exactly as the catalog names it for pi-durable, a pattern for the rest). On tmux, copilot/omp/codex/pi-durable are refused BEFORE any window opens when their birth, MCP, receive or visible-identity units are absent, pi-durable also on named refusals of its installed carrier or exact SDK set, and codex also needs the operator-owned app-server socket entwurf never starts; in herdr they are refused by name first. Optional placement.tmuxSession is a TMUX-ONLY seat naming ONE EXISTING session and ALWAYS wins; omitted, the seat follows the CALLER, never the backend opened: a CODEX CALLER opens beside its own TUI pane, every other caller in its own session; a missing one is tmux-session-missing and NOTHING is created. In herdr the field is refused by name. Do not put secrets in the task — model and task argv are visible to same-user processes.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside this durable host through the entwurf-bridge and hand it a first task (backend, model and task required; optional cwd and placement). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH receipt or its named refusal — not a started runtime, a delivered task or a reply; the sibling's callback names it. Opening beside this host needs the tmux pane this host itself was launched in.
amendments.new: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside this durable host through the entwurf-bridge and hand it a first task (backend, model and task required; optional cwd and placement). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH receipt or its named refusal — not a started runtime, a delivered task or a reply; the sibling's callback names it. Inside herdr, it requests a new unfocused tab in this host's workspace for pi, claude-code or pi-durable; elsewhere it needs the tmux pane this host itself was launched in.
